pain: Collectors retry, reorder fields and send malformed Activity Events; the ledger must refuse bad input and classify repeats before any write, and the current shared validator cannot run in the deployed Workers runtime.
who: HOME's trusted internal consumers: Collectors that append Activity Events and Projections that replay them.
done_when: @zs-home/shared-contracts gains a Workers-safe Activity Event validator generated at build time with Ajv standalone code from activity-event.v1.schema.json; it uses no node:fs and compiles nothing at runtime, and a Node test shows it accepts and refuses the same fixtures as validateActivityEvent.
A local wrangler dev smoke (no login, no deploy) runs the built Worker in workerd and appends one synthetic Activity Event, proving no runtime code generation is reached.

The ledger additionally refuses an Event Key whose second segment differs from kind, and input outside the RFC 8785 JSON domain (undefined, BigInt, non-finite numbers, lone surrogates, non-plain objects) returns refused before any storage call.

The comparison digest excludes only provenance.collectedAt, provenance.collector and provenance.collectorVersion; tests show reordered keys plus changed collection fields compare equal and any other change compares different.
Tests cover missing Provenance, an offset timestamp and a wrong Kind segment returning refused, and an Activity Event without an Identity Binding kept with only actor.sourceAccount.
The validated input is snapshotted through canonical JSON, and a pure test shows that mutating the caller object afterwards does not change the snapshot.
Classification is pure: classify.ts and validate.ts import no storage API, and npm run check passes.

out_of_scope: Live Collectors and Identity Binding config
Projections, Activity Calendar and Project Timeline
Any HOME API, route, MCP server or Scope enforcement
Real customer or account data; fixtures are synthetic
Cloudflare deploys, wrangler login and creating any Cloudflare resource
Merges and paid model spend without Danny's yes
